_note: Respellings applied ONLY to text on its way to Google Cloud Text-to-Speech. The screen, the chat history and the ledger all keep the correct spelling — this file changes what is said, never what is written.
_why_respelling: Chirp 3 HD does have an official customPronunciations field taking IPA or X-SAMPA, but the docs mark it Experimental and do not list which locales support it, Thai included. Respelling needs no phonetic alphabet, anyone can add an entry by ear, and it works today. See server/README.md for the comparison.
_rules: Since 0.38 entries match WHOLE WORDS, found by the Thai segmenter (kiosk_broker/wordcut.py), so an entry of any length is safe — 'ดี' matches the word ดี and never the start of ดีใจ or ดีเซล. A spelling may span several words (อากาศดี is two); write it without spaces. "space_around": true puts a space on each side of the word in what the voice is sent, with or without a respelling. If segmentation is unavailable the broker falls back to the old string search, where entries shorter than 3 characters are skipped.

entries.why: Read aloud as อา-กา-สะ-ดี. The ศ closes อากาศ (pronounced อา-กาด) and is not the start of a syllable with ดี. Respelling the final as ด and inserting a space forces both the right final consonant and the right word boundary.

ศ is the final consonant here, in มาตราแม่กด, and is said as ด: อา-กาด. The voice sounded the ศ. Source: DLTV worksheet มาตราตัวสะกด แม่กด (โครงการสื่อ ๖๐ พรรษาสมเด็จพระเทพรัตนราชสุดาฯ), which lists ศ among the 16 finals of แม่กด and gives อากาศ as the example. The longer อากาศดี entry still applies first.

Production, 2026-09-23 after aab1e71: "กำลังเปิดแผนที่ไปให้พี่นะครับ" was heard as "เปิดแผน ที่ ไป" — the voice split แผนที่ in two (เปิดแผน, then ที่ไป). The text sent had no space; the split was the voice's. A space on each side of the word leaves it no other way to read it. Until 0.38 this was two phrase entries (เปิดแผนที่ → เปิด แผนที่, แผนที่ไป → แผนที่ ไป) because the string search could not match a word; with the words known it is one entry, and the text sent is the same.

_how_to_add: Add {"spelling": ..., "say": ..., "why": ...} and optionally "space_around": true. Add only words heard wrong on the real voice, and say in "why" what was heard. Longest entries apply first. The broker re-reads this file when it changes; no restart. A broken file is ignored with a warning in the journal. If the segmenter splits a word wrongly, add the word to tts_words.txt instead.
